operations.name: edgeNodesList
operations.summary: List registered Edges in the current workspace
operations.description: Center-only business discovery; do not set X-Fleet-Node-Id. Returns minimal inventory, not management credentials. Status is infrastructure state, not a guarantee of business reachability. Use each returned ID with native target catalog, Source documents, Stream programs and Collection APIs. Check remoteStreamTarget on the Cloud; bind the existing Edge Source with target:{fleetNodeId,sourceId,configRevision} and omit the node header on Cloud Stream requests. For example, Modbus supports on-demand reads and periodic polling at the Edge. For source-event entries, bind ranges and optional pollIntervalMs (100 to 3600000 ms, defaults to the Edge Source interval) and receive values, unitId, table and address for each modbus:<rangeId>. MQTT, OPC UA and USB HID also support Edge-owned continuous collection. Configure acquisition requirements on Stream bindings; device connection credentials stay on Edge. Identical demands share a Watch with independent consumers. Inspect Source runtime edgeSubscriptions separately for collection and delivery state; lastCloudDataAt is durable capture, not Collection commit. Replay is bounded by a 120-second lease and per-consumer 256-event/1-MiB memory buffer, and does not survive an Edge process restart. No end-to-end exactly-once guarantee.
